raw_text: Exercise Himgiri Prahar 2024: The Indian Army's Northern Command will conduct its annual winter combat readiness exercise from 08-22 March 2024 in the Ladakh and Eastern Ladakh sectors. The exercise involves elements of XIV Corps and will validate operational preparedness for high-altitude warfare. Routine logistics and troop movements associated with the exercise will occur along NH-1D and feeder roads. This is a pre-scheduled annual exercise conducted every year since 2018.
